t: What are the COSO Frameworks? How are They Used? | Definition from TechTarget
s: The COSO frameworks are documents that provide guidance on establishing internal controls and enterprise risk management (ERM) programs in organizations. Collectively, the frameworks are designed to help improve organizational performance in areas that include business operations, corporate reporting, regulatory compliance and risk management.
